cards.title: Core Map
cards.why: Repo identity, current risk, authority labels, safe next commands.
cards.saves_you_from: wrong project state, stale assumptions, unsafe first actions

cards.title: Structural Map
cards.why: Files, symbols, imports, consumers, entrypoints; read before edits/refactors.
cards.saves_you_from: missed consumers, wrong impact, blind dependency edits

cards.title: Runtime Map
cards.why: Runtime behavior, framework hints, env contracts, reachability.
cards.saves_you_from: wrong tests, hidden runtime coupling, config mistakes

cards.title: Memory Trail
cards.why: Prior decisions, outcomes, tasks, and AICX continuity when available.
cards.saves_you_from: repeated work, forgotten decisions, reimplemented tasks

cards.title: Verification Gates
cards.why: Commands and likely tests most relevant to validate changes.
cards.saves_you_from: wrong validation path, skipped downstream checks, false confidence

cards.title: Risk Register
cards.why: Hotspots, cache/snapshot health, stale assumptions, next risk-reducing actions.
cards.saves_you_from: release blockers, high fan-in surprises, stale-cache decisions

message: This atlas contains the repo understanding an agent would otherwise rediscover manually. Start with manifest.md, then read the recommended cards; broad repo-level answers are incomplete until core, structural, and runtime are read.
